title: Membership in an unordered pair meets a chosen representative
statement: Let $e$ be an unordered pair of elements of a type $\alpha$ with decidable equality, and let $(a, b)$ be the ordered pair chosen as a representative of $e$. If an element $z$ belongs to $e$, then $z = a$ or $z = b$.
hypotheses_covered: z belongs to the unordered pair e
replaced:
If $z$ belongs to the unordered pair $e$, then $z$ equals one of the two components of
the chosen representative of $e$.
